card.name: Just before Renaissance artist names
card.fires_on: Words right before a famous Italian or French Renaissance-era artist or thinker is named, such as a verb, 'of', a title or a comma. It appears in art-history text about Florence, the Uffizi and Medici patrons.

modes.label: Verb or title before artist
modes.description: A commissioning verb, role word or 'of' leads into the name of an architect or artist.
modes.example: the new grand duke, Francis I,<< commissioned>> Bernardo Buontalenti to convert

modes.label: Inside role words and punctuation
modes.description: Part of a role word like architect, or a comma or bracket, just before a famous name.
modes.example: engaged the painter-arch<<itect>> Giorgio Vasari to plan a

modes.label: List of famous names
modes.description: A comma inside a list of famous historical figures, with the next name coming up.
modes.example: including Sir Isaac Newton<<,>> Botticelli, Victor Hugo and Leonardo

card.writes: It pushes toward names starting with Bl or Leon and some Chinese name characters, and away from unrelated word starts like hel and Aero.
card.plain: It marks the spot where the text is about to name a famous Renaissance artist or architect.
